reviewType: Automated cache-identity, completeness and deterministic aggregation review; not independent expert certification

decisions.sourceIdentity: Every recomputation used a cached source whose hash equals the already published canonical observation hash.
decisions.observationValidity: Publish explicit valid-day and valid-year denominators; do not impute missing observations.
decisions.equalValidYearWeighting: Retain equal weighting across valid years of the 1991-2020 normal.
decisions.scoreInputs: Migration is allowed only where all twelve months retain every required scoring input.
decisions.recommendationPolicy: Rebuild scores from the current versioned policy after migration; preserve independent precipitation and persistent-snow holds.

notApproved: removal of any published review hold
